test_objective: Check that one can retrieve an entity with format or options query params
keywords: Retrieve Entity With Format Or Options Query Params

test_cases.name: 018_15_01 RetrieveWithKeyValuesFormat
test_cases.doc: Check that one can retrieve with format query param having keyValues value
test_cases.template: Retrieve Entity With Format Or Options Query Params
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/{id}'
        method set to 'GET'
        Get Entity Request: and
    Query Parameter: id set to '${entity_id}' and
    Query Parameter: accept set to 'application/ld+json' and
    Query Parameter: format set to 'keyValues' and
    Query Parameter: options set to '${EMPTY}'
}
